items.source: This class provides an empty implementation of FiltersListener, which can be extended to create a listener which only needs to handle a subset of the available methods.
items.translation: 该类提供了FiltersListener的空实现，可以扩展它以创建只需处理可用方法子集的监听器。

items.source: This class provides an empty implementation of FiltersVisitor, which can be extended to create a visitor which only needs to handle a subset of the available methods.
items.translation: 该类提供了FiltersVisitor的空实现，可以扩展它以创建只需处理可用方法子集的访问者。

items.source: This interface defines a complete listener for a parse tree produced by FiltersParser.
items.translation: 该接口定义了由 FiltersParser 生成的解析树的完整监听器。

items.source: This interface defines a complete generic visitor for a parse tree produced by FiltersParser.
items.translation: 该接口定义了一个完整的泛型访问者，用于处理由 FiltersParser 生成的解析树。
